module_summary: Level detector with state machine implementing priority-based output flags from input selector.

anchors.name: lvl
anchors.why: State register tracking level status and controlling output logic

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Input command selector controlling decoding of priority flags

anchors.name: fr2
anchors.why: Output flag 2 indicating high-level status condition

anchors.name: fr1
anchors.why: Output flag 1 indicating mid-level status condition

anchors.name: fr0
anchors.why: Output flag 0 indicating low-level status condition

anchors.name: dfr
anchors.why: Differential flag indicating intermediate state condition

anchors.name: hi
anchors.why: High bit extracted from input selector s[2]

anchors.name: mid
anchors.why: Mid bit extracted from input selector s[1]

anchors.name: lo
anchors.why: Low bit extracted from input selector s[0]

anchors.name: up_band
anchors.why: Upper band flag combining lvl[1] and lvl[4]

anchors.name: low_pair
anchors.why: Lower pair flag combining lvl[0] and lvl[3]

anchors.name: bot
anchors.why: Bottom flag derived from inverted lvl[5]

anchors.name: n_hi
anchors.why: Inverted high bit for conditional logic

anchors.name: n_mid
anchors.why: Inverted mid bit for conditional logic

anchors.name: n_lo
anchors.why: Inverted low bit for conditional logic

anchors.name: reset
anchors.why: Reset signal clearing state to empty level

groups.name: State_Register
groups.description: Level state register with combinational next-state logic

groups.name: Helper_Signals
groups.description: Derived flags from state for output computation

groups.name: Negation_Logic
groups.description: Inverted decoder bits for conditional expressions

groups.name: Output_Flags
groups.description: Priority-based status flags derived from state and input
